## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2012-11-19: S-1/A attaches form-of TRA as Exhibit 10.20
- 2012-12-12: TRA executed at IPO closing (December 18, 2012 IPO close); 8-K filed December 19, 2012 attaches executed TRA as Exhibit 10.2

#### Sponsor monetization without contract change

- 2015-02-06: Blackstone and First Reserve fully exchange remaining 3,804,653 PBF LLC Series A Units in secondary offering; retain TRA-beneficiary rights

#### Valuation allowance write-down and recovery

- 2020-12-31: Pandemic-era losses produce full valuation allowance on underlying deferred tax assets; recorded TRA liability written down to $0
- 2023-12-31: Liability rebuilt to $336.6M as profitability returns; $43.0M payment for tax year 2022 paid January 2024
- 2025-01: $130.8M payment (incl. $5.4M interest) for tax year 2023; $168.2M liability at year-end 2025

## Explanation

PBF Energy Inc. became the TRA obligor on December 12, 2012 at the closing of its Up-C IPO, with PBF Energy Company LLC's Members (principally Blackstone, First Reserve, and management) as beneficiaries. The TRA pays beneficiaries 85% of the cumulative net realized tax benefits from Section 743(b) / 754 basis step-ups arising from exchanges of PBF LLC Series A Units for Class A common stock plus TRA-imputed interest; no pre-IPO NOL coverage. No amendment has been filed in the contract's life. The contract has run continuously despite two notable events: Blackstone and First Reserve fully monetized their Class A position in a February 2015 secondary while retaining their TRA-beneficiary rights, and pandemic-era losses produced a full valuation allowance that wrote the recorded liability down to zero at year-end 2020 without terminating the contract. Profitability and basis step-up amortization rebuilt the liability to $336.6M by 2023, with $43.0M and $130.8M cash payments made in the Januaries of 2024 and 2025; the December 31, 2025 liability stands at $168.2M with the next January payment pending. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
